## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows `<type>/<issue>-<short-description>`, targets `develop` (`main` only for releases), and the PR title is a Conventional Commit

- [ ] Retrieval or ranking changes include benchmark numbers
- [ ] No secrets, uploaded documents or corpus files committed
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md`) when relevant
